title: Turkey Isn't Why You're Sleepy 😴
title_options: Your Thanksgiving Nap Isn't the Turkey 🦃
Blame the Pie, Not the Turkey 😴
seo_intro:
Does turkey make you sleepy? Not really: turkey has about as much tryptophan as chicken or beef.
The Thanksgiving nap comes from the meal itself: about 3,000 calories by one estimate, plus carbs, pie and alcohol.
sources_text: USDA FoodData Central (tryptophan content of roasted turkey, chicken and beef: similar amounts); NIH MedlinePlus (tryptophan is an amino acid the body uses to make serotonin and melatonin); Calorie Control Council estimate, widely reported (about 3,000 calories for a typical Thanksgiving dinner); scientific consensus on post-meal sleepiness (large meals, carbohydrates and alcohol)
disclaimer: Original illustrations (simplified). Synthetic voice and AI-generated music.
comment: Who always naps after Thanksgiving dinner in your family? 😴🦃👇
